# netbox_aggregates (Data Source)

Retrieves all aggregates from NetBox. Narrow the result with filter blocks and cap it with limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_aggregates" "example" {
  filter {
    name  = "family"
    value = "4"
  }
}

output "aggregates" {
  value = data.netbox_aggregates.example.aggregates
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filters that select which items are returned. Each filter is a name/value pair. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 0, which returns all items.

### Read-Only

- `aggregates` (Attributes List) The aggregates found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aggregates))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the field to filter by.
- `value` (String) The value of the field to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--aggregates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `aggregates`

Read-Only:

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the aggregates.
- `created` (String) When the aggregates was created.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the aggregates, as a map of field name to value.
- `date_added` (String) The date added of the aggregates.
- `description` (String) A description of the aggregates.
- `family` (String) The family of the aggregates.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the aggregates.
- `last_updated` (String) When the aggregates was last changed.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the aggregates.
- `prefix` (String) The prefix in CIDR notation.
- `rir_id` (Number) The ID of the rir associated with the aggregates.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
- `tenant_id` (Number) The ID of the tenant associated with the aggregates.
